title: Pun: Format, Lint, and Analyze PHP With One Rust Binary
content:
Pun is a Rust binary in public beta that formats, lints, and analyzes PHP 8.3+ code, installs Composer packages, and reads one pun.toml config file.

The post Pun: Format, Lint, and Analyze PHP With One Rust Binary appeared first on Laravel News.
